strategies.name: Fused Buffer Preparation Single-Pass
strategies.desc: Pre-compute all 7 masked buffers (iterations 2-8) before any all-reduce dispatch, storing them in a single concatenated tensor of shape (7, 9*2048). Dispatch 7 all-reduces back-to-back on slices of this buffer, allowing hardware to potentially pipeline communications. Still 9 total dispatches (1 initial + 1 final + 7 windowed) but enables better overlap of computation and communication through batched buffer preparation.

strategies.name: Hierarchical Two-Level Reduction Tree
strategies.desc: Exploit the 224-rank world size (224 = 32 × 7) by organizing into hierarchical groups. Perform intra-group reductions first (8 dependent all-reduces within each group of 32 ranks using reduce-scatter + all-gather pattern), then inter-group aggregation (single all-reduce across 7 group leaders), followed by broadcast back. Reduces effective world size per operation but adds extra dispatch overhead; trades per-dispatch latency for increased dispatch count (~16-20 total dispatches).

strategies.name: Block-Wise Pipelined Reduction Waves
strategies.desc: Instead of processing all 9 blocks together in each all-reduce, partition the 8 dependent iterations into waves where independent blocks can be reduced in parallel. Since each rank's window covers 3 contiguous blocks, partition the 9 blocks into 3 groups of 3, and pipeline the windowed reductions across these groups with overlapping all-reduce calls on disjoint block sets. Approximately 12-15 dispatches (initial full + 3 groups × 4 waves) but smaller payloads and potential hardware overlap.

strategies.name: Reduce-Scatter All-Gather Decomposition
strategies.desc:
Replace each masked all-reduce with a reduce-scatter followed by all-gather pattern, where reduce-scatter aggregates only the blocks each rank needs and all-gather redistributes results. This transforms 8 all-reduce operations into 16 operations (8 reduce-scatter + 8 all-gather) but each operation moves less data (approximately 3/9 of the payload for windowed blocks). Total 17 dispatches (1 initial full + 16 decomposed) trading dispatch count for per-dispatch bandwidth reduction.
